summary: FASE 8 - Portal Cliente / Alfred Onramp + Offramp (mock mode) tested end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest pass (8 existing + 2 new added by this iteration). Frontend: onramp end-to-end happy path verified (quote ARS 100k -> 96.31 USDC, 60s countdown, Confirmar y pagar -> /checkout with PENDING + Alfred ID + 5s SWR polling, mock-settle -> automatic redirect to /success with check icon, USDC amount, alfred_id, coelsa_id, fee, rate, CTAs Empezar a invertir + Hacer otra carga). Transactions page renders with 12 rows including the 3 new onramps, filters (tipo+status) and CSV button visible. Dashboard CTA buttons link correctly: action-deposit -> /client/onramp, action-invest -> /client/investments, action-withdraw -> /client/offramp. Finpact (KYB pending) gating works correctly on /client/onramp and /client/offramp (shows ClientGateBanner with data-status=pending + page-level 'Onboarding pendiente' empty state, no Confirmar button rendered). Offramp empty state (balance=0 + source=balance) verified.

missing_data_testids.note: Content renders correctly (96.31 USDC, alfred/coelsa IDs, both CTAs) but data-testid attributes are not present, making future E2E selectors brittle.
Couldn't be observed in the rendered form because alemany balance is 0 (empty state). Recommend adding data-testid so they exist regardless of which branch the page renders.

action_items: (Recommended) Add data-testid attributes on the Onramp success page (amount, alfred-id, coelsa-id, invest CTA, again CTA) for stable E2E selectors.
(Recommended) Add data-testid attributes on the Offramp form (source tabs balance/position, amount, target currency, bank-holder/iban/name, confirm) so they survive the empty-state vs form branches.
(Recommended) Add data-testid='tx-filter-type', 'tx-filter-status', 'tx-export-csv' to the transactions page filters + CSV button.

(Informational) DoD copy mentions 'source: balance | wallet' but the Pydantic schema enforces 'balance' | 'position'. UI labels appear consistent with backend; if 'wallet' was intended it must be added to the schema's Literal as well.
critical_code_review_comments: Webhook idempotency: existing pytest used a fixed event_id which leaked across runs (KeyError on replay vs fresh). Fixed by using uuid4() per test. The endpoint correctly returns {ok:true, event_id, type} on first hit and {ok:true, idempotent:true} on replay — good behaviour, just unstable test fixture.

Mock-settle endpoint is correctly guarded by current_mode()=='mock' and synthesizes the same webhook event (HMAC-signed) that the public webhook handler would receive — clean parity between real and mock paths.
client_alfred.py is 706 lines, ON the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into 4 modules: onramp_routes.py, offramp_routes.py, webhook_routes.py, mock_routes.py for future maintainability.

_ensure_tx_for_onramp + _ensure_tx_for_offramp helpers correctly de-dupe via prosper_tx_id ('onramp::<id>'/'offramp::<id>'), so re-running settle or replaying webhooks won't create duplicate TRANSACTIONS rows.

GET /client/onramp/orders/{id} lazily refreshes status from the adapter on every read while order is 'pending'. This is the right pattern for mock auto-settle but in real mode it will add a round-trip to Alfred on every poll — acceptable but worth a TTL cache for production.
Onramp checkout page exposes the raw alfred_id in the UI ('alf_on_...') which is fine for ops/visibility but worth confirming with product that this is desired customer-facing copy.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 8 is stable. The Offramp FORM (with source tabs, amount, target currency, bank account) was NOT visually inspected on /client/offramp because alemany's balance is 0 and source=balance defaults to the empty state. To force the form to render, either switch the source tab to 'position' (real query param TBD — investigate the page source) or first run an onramp and wait for a subscription so balance > 0. The backend offramp create path IS fully covered by pytest (test_offramp_create_succeeds_with_matching_holder, test_offramp_rejects_mismatched_holder). The /client/offramp/[id]/status timeline page also wasn't visually verified — recommend creating an offramp via backend API (source='position'), then visiting /client/offramp/{id}/status to confirm the 5-step timeline + color badges. Working selectors confirmed this iteration: [data-testid='onramp-confirm'], [data-testid='onramp-amount'], [data-testid='onramp-quote-target'], [data-testid='onramp-countdown'], [data-testid='client-gate-banner'][data-status='pending'], [data-testid='action-deposit'|'action-invest'|'action-withdraw'], [data-testid='tx-table'].
rca_of_flaky_webhook_test: test_webhook_accepts_valid_signature_and_is_idempotent failed on first run because the hardcoded event_id 'evt_test_idem_abc123' had already been processed in an earlier test run (likely from the main agent's smoke run before handing off). The replay path correctly returns {'ok':true, 'idempotent':true} WITHOUT echoing event_id, so the assertion r1.json()['event_id'] == ... raised KeyError. Mitigation applied: generate a fresh uuid4-based event_id per invocation so the test is self-contained and re-runnable. Endpoint behaviour is correct and unchanged.
